_comment: Shared sensor & entity definitions for ALL EHG vehicles (v2.43.0+).
_doc: Only entries guaranteed on every SCU belong here (buses 1, 3, 30, 45).
Brand/model-specific buses go in hymer.json, eriba.json, etc.
Keys: bus_id,sensor_id. Values: objects with decode + entity metadata.
No platform = decode-only (value stored but no HA entity created).
Array format [name, unit, transform] still supported for backward compat.
_naming: ENTITY NAMING CONVENTION (v2.70.1+). 'name' is the stable object_id suffix HA uses to
build the entity_id. It is FROZEN once shipped - NEVER rename an existing entity, that
breaks user dashboards & automations. A correction is done by adding a NEW alias, never
<group>     = what the user thinks in: a function domain (fridge, heater, water, solar,
battery/bms, tank, sat, tpms, awning, light, habitation) OR a brand/product
when the brand IS the identity (dometic, truma, alde, victron, cerbo).
<qualifier> = short disambiguator, ONLY when two devices share a group on overlapping
vehicles (fridge_absorber vs fridge_compressor; heater vs truma vs alde).
<function>  = the measured/controlled quantity (voltage, current, soc, door, power, mode,
Never encode the EHG componentId or the bus number in the name (e.g. 'dometicseries10_*'
or 'bus9_*' are internal-only, not user-facing). Every appliance entity carries
require_observed so it materialises only when the vehicle actually reports its bus.

3,3._doc: Water pump on/off state. Readback sensor for the water_pump_ctrl switch. Legacy name was 'charger_active' (misidentified as EBL charger in early development). Confirmed as water pump on both S 600 and ML-T 570 (v2.63.2, issue #8).
3,3.name: water_pump_active

30,2._doc: EHG: ScuInternalTime — SCU internal clock, not GPS-derived
30,2.name: scu_internal_time

30,3._doc: EHG: LteConnectionQuality — LTE signal quality string (e.g. 'excellent')
30,3.name: lte_connection_quality

30,5._doc: EHG: ScuVoltage — SCU supply voltage (float, V)
30,5.name: scu_voltage

30,6._doc: EHG: PairedBTDevices — number of paired Bluetooth devices (int)
30,6.name: paired_bt_devices

30,7._doc: EHG: ConnectedBTDevices — number of currently connected BT devices (int)
30,7.name: connected_bt_devices

30,8._doc: EHG: BatteryCutoffSwitch — battery disconnect/cutoff switch state (bool)
30,8.name: battery_cutoff_switch

30,9._doc: EHG: UserActive — user activity flag (bool, rw). Not LTE connected.
30,9.name: user_active

30,10._doc: EHG: DPlus — D+ alternator charge signal from chassis (bool)
30,10.name: d_plus_signal

30,11._doc: EHG: WakeUpChassis — chassis wake-up trigger (bool, write-only). May not produce readable data.
30,11.name: wake_up_chassis

30,12._doc: EHG: BatterySwitchActive — 12V battery switch active (bool). True = 12V ON.
30,12.name: battery_switch_active

30,13.name: shoreline_connected_scu

30,14.name: vehicle_movement

60,1._doc: Dometic compressor fridge (bus 60 = DometicCompressorFridge). Universal across EHG brands (HYMER, Eriba, ...) — created only when the vehicle reports bus 60 (require_observed). Slot 1 = UserMode (string rw per decompiled EHG app componentId 60, id 1): 'Performance Cooling'/'Silent Mode'/'Turbo Mode'. Read sensor for the writable fridge_dometic_mode select.
60,1.name: dometic_fridge_mode

60,2._doc: Dometic Temperature/cooling level (int 1-5, unit 'step', rw per decompiled EHG app componentId 60, id 2, range min 1/max 5). NO 0/Off value — Off is done via PowerOn (slot 8). Read sensor for the writable cooling-step select.
60,2.name: dometic_fridge_level

60,8._doc: Dometic PowerOn on/off (bool rw per decompiled EHG app componentId 60, id 8). Drives the Off branch of the cooling-step select. On/off write on slot 8 CONFIRMED on-vehicle by HYMER Dometic owner 'Jos' (2026-08-23).
60,8.name: dometic_fridge_power

60,9._doc: Dometic PowerSource (string r): 'AC power'/'DC12V power'/'DC24V power'.
60,9.name: dometic_fridge_power_source

60,16._doc: Dometic WarningErrorInformation (int 0-127, r per decompiled EHG app componentId 60, id 16). For the fridge door: 0 = closed, 10 = open — CONFIRMED on-vehicle by HYMER Dometic owner 'Jos' (2026-08-23). Raw code kept as a diagnostic sensor; the door-open state is surfaced by the static binary_sensor 'dometic_fridge_door' (on_value 10), also observation-gated on this slot.
60,16.name: dometic_fridge_warning

sensors._dometic_s10_doc: Dometic Series 10 absorber fridge (EHG bus 9 = DometicSeries10, e.g. RMD 10.5). A DIFFERENT product from the Dometic COMPRESSOR fridge on bus 60 (dometic_*, confirmed on-vehicle by owner 'Jos'), hence the dometic_s10_* prefix. Universal optional component - observation-gated so it only materialises on vehicles that actually report bus 9. Read sensors per the decompiled EHG app (componentId 9); the power/mode/level slots (1-3) are rw and are exposed here as read sensors - a writable select/switch can follow once a Series-10 owner confirms the write path on-vehicle. UNVERIFIED: no Series-10 owner has confirmed yet, semantics taken from the EHG metadata.
sensors._tpms_doc: TPMS (EHG bus 100, component 'TPMS', kind tpms). Universal optional component - observation-gated so it only materialises on vehicles that actually report bus 100. Pressures are int with a declared range 0-9500 'psi'; that range implies a scaled raw unit (e.g. psi*100), so pressures are shipped enabled:false with SCALE UNVERIFIED until a TPMS-equipped vehicle confirms the transform. Temperatures are EHG floats (direct degC per the Alde/Truma convention; -273 = no-data sentinel). Status/firmware are strings (safe decode).
sensors._cerbo_doc: Victron Cerbo GX energy monitor (EHG bus 97, component 'CerboGX', kind power_system). Universal optional component - observation-gated so it only materialises on vehicles that actually report bus 97. Distinct from the Victron inverter/charger on bus 121 (victron_*), hence the cerbo_* prefix. Semantics from the decompiled EHG app (componentId 97): LPG levels + battery V/A/SoC are direct floats/ints (safe). Two fields are shipped enabled:false with SCALE UNVERIFIED until a Cerbo-equipped vehicle confirms: slot 6 time_remaining (EHG unit is a bogus '%', raw max 99999999 => likely seconds/minutes) and slot 7 solar_panel_power (raw max 33542 'W' is implausibly high for a camper array => likely a scaled raw int).

97,6._doc: Cerbo GX battery time-remaining. EHG unit is a bogus '%' and raw max is 99999999 (likely seconds or minutes) - SCALE/UNIT UNVERIFIED, shipped enabled:false without a unit until a Cerbo vehicle confirms.
97,6.name: cerbo_battery_time_remaining

97,7._doc: Cerbo GX solar array power. Raw int with an implausible max of 33542 'W' for a camper array => likely a scaled raw unit - SCALE UNVERIFIED, shipped enabled:false until a Cerbo vehicle confirms the transform.
97,7.name: cerbo_solar_power

sensors._awning_doc: ZipDee power awning (EHG bus 107, component 'ZipDeePowerAwning', kind awning). Universal optional component - observation-gated. Read-only status slots per the decompiled EHG app (componentId 107): slot 5 status (string), slot 9/10 tilt front/rear status (bool). The open/close/tilt/move-position controls (slots 1-4,6-8) are writable and left for a future cover/number entity.
sensors._solar_cbe_doc: CBE solar charger (EHG bus 117, component 'CBESolarCharger', kind solar_charger). Universal optional component - observation-gated. Named solar_cbe_* to stay distinct from the Voltronic MPPT solar_* on bus 8. Voltage/current are EHG floats with plausible ranges (0-125 V / 0-50 A) so they ship enabled.
sensors._battery_guard_doc: BatteryGuard 1000 DC power guard (EHG bus 96, component 'BatteryGuard1000'). Universal optional component - observation-gated. Read-only fault/firmware slots per the decompiled EHG app (componentId 96): slot 3 battery_low_warning (bool), slot 4 device_failure (int 0-2), slot 5 firmware (string). The primary/auxiliary DC-disconnect controls (slots 1-2) are writable and left for a future switch entity.
sensors._hss_doc: HYMER Smart Sensors (aftermarket BLE sensors paired to the SCU) + the fine wired water levels. Moved here from hymer.json so any brand with these components gets them automatically. The HSS tyre/temp/contact/gas sensors use the auto-slot mechanism (bus_name 'auto:<group>:{n}', distinguished by PIA field 10 device id) - they are inherently observation-gated because the '{n}' template is never registered as a concrete entity (devices #1..N are materialised at runtime). The fine water levels on bus 76 use FIXED pin-6 (fresh) / pin-7 (grey) discriminators; unlike the auto-slot templates they WOULD be created unconditionally, so they carry require_observed to avoid phantom entities on vehicles that only have the coarse EBL levels on bus 3 (fresh_water_level_ebl / grey_water_level_ebl).

70,1#t{n}._doc: HYMER Smart tyre sensor #{n} (auto-numbered). Devices #1..N materialised at runtime. Slot 5 (RSSI) intentionally unmapped.
70,1#t{n}.name: hss_tyre{n}_status

74,1#tp{n}._doc: HYMER Smart temperature sensor #{n} (auto-numbered) on bus 74.
74,1#tp{n}.name: hss_temp{n}_temperature

73,1#c{n}._doc: HYMER Smart contact sensor #{n} (auto-numbered) on bus 73.
73,1#c{n}.name: hss_contact{n}_status

71,1#g{n}._doc: HYMER Smart gas-bottle sensor #{n} (auto-numbered) on bus 71.
71,1#g{n}.name: hss_gaslevel{n}_percent

switches._doc: Universal switches on bus 3 (habitation electrics). write_type: how the PIA command is sent. on_value: readback value meaning ON. holdoff_off: seconds to hold optimistic OFF (for SCU bounce-back).

climate._doc: Universal writable controls shared across all EHG brands. The Dometic compressor fridge (bus 60 = DometicCompressorFridge) is a fixed EHG component bound to bus 60 on every brand, so its controls live here and are observation-gated (require_observed) — the select entities are created only once the vehicle reports bus 60. On-vehicle confirmed via the HYMER-Group SCU (owner 'Jos').

fridge_dometic_cooling_step._doc: Dometic compressor fridge (bus 60 = DometicCompressorFridge) Off/1-5 cooling-step control. Ground truth from the decompiled EHG app (componentId 60): PowerOn = slot 8 (bool rw), Temperature = slot 2 (int rw, range 1-5, NO 0/Off). Mirrors the Thetford drivers (bus 34/32/114): power sid 8 (bool) then cooling-step sid 2 (uint). Off routes to PowerOn=false. Both the cooling-level write (slot 2) AND the on/off write (slot 8, Off branch) CONFIRMED on-vehicle by HYMER Dometic owner 'Jos' (2026-08-23). require_observed: created only when bus 60 is reported.
fridge_dometic_cooling_step.name: Dometic fridge cooling step

fridge_dometic_mode._doc: Dometic compressor fridge user mode = the EHG app's 'Modus' selector (bus 60 slot 1 = UserMode, string rw per decompiled EHG app componentId 60, id 1). Options are the SCU wire values from the decompiled stringRange ('Performance Cooling'/'Silent Mode'/'Turbo Mode'); the app LOCALIZES these for display (DE: Normal/Leise/Turbo). Options MUST stay as the wire values for readback (sensor dometic_fridge_mode 60,1) and write to match — do NOT relabel. WRITE PATH on bus 60 slot 1 CONFIRMED on-vehicle by HYMER Dometic owner 'Jos' (2026-08-24). require_observed: created only when bus 60 is reported.
fridge_dometic_mode.name: Dometic fridge mode
